preconditions.description: The dimensions n, m and the required distinct count K are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(board) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in board) and all(-1 <= x <= n*m for row in board for x in row)
preconditions.description: The board matrix has dimensions n x m and contains integers between -1 and n*m inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(costs) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in costs) and all(1 <= x <= 100000 for row in costs for x in row)
preconditions.description: The cost matrix has dimensions n x m and contains integers between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(is_valid_block(S, board, K) for S in all_connected_subsets(n, m)) else str(min(total_cost(S, costs) for S in all_connected_subsets(n, m) if is_valid_block(S, board, K)))
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if no valid connected block exists; otherwise, it is the minimum total cost among all valid connected blocks.
